description: Save a property search for the connected user so they get alerts when new matching listings appear (e.g. "2-bed apartments for rent under $800 in Villa Morra"). Requires a connected account — if not connected, use connect_account first. Uses the same filters as search_listings. Returns the saved id.

alert_frequency.description: How often to be alerted about new matches (default daily)

name.description: Optional label for the saved search

name: save_search
title: save_search
